gaps.sentence: Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.
'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.

gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.
'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (DIFFICULT) terrain slowed the rescue team.
gaps.explanation: 'Difficult terrain' — adjective needed; 'difficulty' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: They're ___ (HOPE) that the talks will resume.
gaps.explanation: 'Be hopeful that…' = feeling hope; 'hopefully' is the adverb.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.
